tests: a launch-failed rolls the worktree back through a symlinked fleet root and through a symlinked worktrees directory

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: src/pool.ts shells out to git and DECIDES on what git prints: resolveDestroy reads `worktree <path>` lines out of `git worktree list --porcelain` and compares each against a path the kernel composed from the fleet root, and a mismatch makes stage 2 refuse the destroy that spawn's rollback depends on. The capture at witness/captures/git-worktree-list-canonicalises-paths.txt:1 is real output of that command taken 2026-09-16 on git 2.43.0, showing a worktree ADDED as $R/link/wt and REPORTED as $R/real/wt, so the assumption that git echoes the spelling it was given is false. The named test re-measures the same contract live against this machine's git before it asserts either arm, so a change in git reddens here rather than leaving the capture asserting a contract git no longer honours. THE TWO MEMBERS ARE STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT AND THE DIFFERENCE IS DEMONSTRATED RATHER THAN CLAIMED: member 0 (string comparison at the call site) reddens ARM A at test/spawn.test.ts:1399, and member 1 (the plausible alternative fix, canonicalising the caller's argument in loadFleet while keeping the string comparison) leaves ARM A GREEN and reddens ARM B at test/spawn.test.ts:1438. A single-site repair therefore cannot pass for a class fix here, because one member survives it.
